description: Mapping poverty and electricity access in South Africa is a data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by University of Cape Town. Mapping poverty and electricity access data using 2011 Census and 2013 General Household Survey data. Coverage: South Africa. The portal files it under the publisher University of Cape Town. Its tags are 91305 Energy Generation, Conversion and Storage Engineering, FOS: Mechanical engineering, FOS: Mechanical engineering. The repository dates the deposit 2019; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and electrification planning. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
